reader.requirement: At --std 85 SPACE, SPACES, ALL SPACE and ALL SPACES must each mean the space character repeated to the size of the associated item (in a VALUE clause, a MOVE to an alphanumeric, alphabetic, edited, group or reference-modified receiver, and a comparison) and exactly one space where no item is associated (DISPLAY, STOP, STRING, UNSTRING), whatever the program collating sequence; a figurative SPACE is not a numeric operand, and a quoted "SPACE" is a nonnumeric literal.
reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectLevel|Year in FigurativeConstants.cs (no hit); FillChar switches only on the receiver's category (national, boolean: neither exists at 85) and the collating sequence (HIGH-/LOW-VALUE only; 'S' is always ' ')

refuter.evidence: refute-1985-004/spc at --std 85, each a context the reader did not try. One-character contexts: e01 UNSTRING 'A  BC' DELIMITED BY SPACE -> [A][ ][BC] and e12 BY SPACES the same (one space each, so the double space yields an empty field), e02 DELIMITED BY ALL SPACE -> [A][BC] (the UNSTRING ALL phrase); e03 STRING X5 DELIMITED BY SPACE -> 'AQ' (delimiter one space); h02 STOP SPACE -> displays one space and continues (cite.py 'OK §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 ... GRL2.2' for 'appears in a DISPLAY, STOP, STRING, or UNSTRING statement, the length of the string is one character'). Sized contexts: e07/e08 an OCCURS DEPENDING group G: MOVE SPACE TO G with C1=3 fills 3 positions only, a later C1=5 or C1=3 view shows the untouched tail; IF G = SPACE false after 'ABC', true after MOVE SPACE; h03 VALUE SPACE on XXBXX and VALUE ALL SPACES on A(3) -> all spaces; MOVE ALL SPACE TO X5(2:3) -> [A   E]; h05 X5(1:2) = ALL SPACES false; h01 INITIALIZE G REPLACING ALPHANUMERIC BY SPACE -> [  07] (only the alphanumeric item); e09 88 W-BLANK VALUE SPACE true, SPACE = W (figurative on the left) true; e11 EVALUATE W WHEN SPACE -> EV; e06 IF Z3 = SPACE (numeric-edited) true. Refusal half: e04 IF NV = SPACE (PIC 9V9) -> COBOL2532 and e05 IF NB = SPACE (PIC 9(4) COMP) -> COBOL2532 (cite.py 'OK §1985:VI.6.3.1.1.2 ... SR3' for 'Numeric and nonnumeric operands may be compared only when their usage is the same'); e10 MOVE SPACE TO a COMP item -> COBOL0819. Edition arm: h04 CALL USING BY CONTENT SPACE -> COBOL0900 (a literal argument is a 2002 form). cite.py 'OK §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 GR2 (4.2.2.2.3 Figurative Constant Values) the text is in GR2'.
